reasons: Red: AI basket drawdown / momentum, Breadth (RSP/SPY, % above 50dma)
Regime: equity-only — Equity and vol rows only; credit is quiet.
Hedge pricing (not in composite): Put skew / cost of tail insurance expensive, Implied vol richness (VIX pctile, IV−RV) moderate

indicators.label: HY credit spread (OAS)
indicators.detail: Level 2.79% (amber ≥4.5%), 5d change +6bp (amber ≥+30bp). A fast widening is the best short-lead credit signal.

indicators.label: CCC credit spread (OAS)
indicators.detail: Junkiest credit tier — closest public proxy for the leveraged AI periphery.

indicators.label: HYG/IEF ratio (credit vs safety)
indicators.detail: High-yield ETF vs Treasuries — a same-day credit read with no FRED lag.

indicators.label: Leveraged loans (BKLN)
indicators.detail: Floating-rate senior secured loans — isolates credit risk from rate moves. Tracking HY closely (+0.8pp 10d).

indicators.label: SOFR − IORB (funding stress)
indicators.detail: Repo rate over the interest-on-reserves floor; a persistent positive spread means funding stress.

indicators.label: Funding tail (SOFR spread + Fed repo use)
indicators.detail: SOFR 99th−1st percentile 13bp (amber ≥30bp); Fed repo ops $0.0bn (3d max) (amber ≥$5bn). Needs both legs to confirm stress over calendar effects.

indicators.label: Chicago Fed NFCI
indicators.detail: Weekly financial-conditions composite; positive = tighter than average.

indicators.label: VIX term structure (VIX/VIX3M)
indicators.detail: ≥1.00 = backwardation — the near-coincident confirmation signal (days of lead at most).

indicators.label: Put skew / cost of tail insurance
indicators.detail: SKEW 147 (expensive ≥145), VVIX 101 (expensive ≥110). Tail insurance is expensive — you would be paying up for the tail. Cost tier, not a risk tier — excluded from the composite.

indicators.label: Implied vol richness (VIX pctile, IV−RV)
indicators.detail: VIX 18.7 sits at the 70th percentile of its trailing year (expensive ≥80th); 20d realized 11.3, so implied carries +7.4 vol points of premium (expensive ≥8). Cost tier, not a risk tier — excluded from the composite.

indicators.label: Periphery canaries (CRWV, ORCL)
indicators.detail: Sharp equity drops or realized-vol spikes in the debt-financed periphery stand in for CDS.

indicators.label: Breadth (RSP/SPY, % above 50dma)
indicators.detail: Narrowing breadth = fragility backdrop; slow signal, low weight.

indicators.label: Yield curve (10y−3m)
indicators.detail: Inversion is a 6–18 month gauge, not a timing signal — capped at amber.

items.headline: Nvidia's 5-year CDS spikes to a record intraday high and stock sheds ~$250B in market cap on report Nvidia is in talks to guarantee $250B of OpenAI's SoftBank-backed Ohio data-center financing (plus up to $350B in chip financing)
items.note: Nvidia's own credit-risk pricing is now reacting to the circular-financing web it created, the clearest sign yet that markets see contagion risk in Nvidia backstopping purchases of its own chips.

items.headline: Mag7 index posts worst day since April 2025 as Big Tech earnings collide with investor revolt over AI spending
items.note: Marks a break in the market's tacit tolerance for unchecked AI capex, coming right before Microsoft/Meta/Amazon/Apple report — a leading indicator for how capex guidance will be priced this week.

items.headline: Rising corporate borrowing costs threaten to squeeze heavily-indebted neoclouds and hyperscalers
items.note: Goldman Sachs' chief credit strategist warns that widening spreads will push AI capex funding toward private markets and JV structures as syndicated credit gets pricier, a direct signal of rising financing stress.

items.headline: Oracle's 5-year CDS climbs to ~203bps, the highest level since contracts began trading in 2008, surpassing financial-crisis-era peaks
items.note: Oracle's CDS has become the market's proxy for AI-capex debt fear given its $120B+ of bonds tied to the Stargate buildout; a record print is a concrete, quantifiable credit-stress signal rather than commentary.

items.headline: CoreWeave sell-off intensifies on capex/spending concerns; analysis flags Altman Z-Score of 0.3 (deep distress zone), $32.9B net debt vs $2.3B cash, and cash interest (~$1.1B/yr) consuming nearly half its cash pile
items.note: Independent analyst warning quantifying balance-sheet strain at the most levered neocloud, worth tracking but not yet a rating-agency action or realized event.

items.headline: Meta reportedly faces higher borrowing costs on a new $12B BlackRock-backed SPV for its Texas AI data center, with investors demanding yields above 7% (~40bps above its 2025 record financing)
items.note: Concrete spread widening on hyperscaler data-center SPV debt, one of the clearest early markers that private-credit investors are repricing AI-buildout risk.

items.headline: 5-year CDS on Oracle, Amazon, Google and Microsoft hit multi-year highs; BofA Global Fund Manager Survey finds 48% of investors now call AI hyperscaler capex the most likely source of a systemic credit event
items.note: Broad-based survey and CDS evidence that AI-capex credit risk has become the consensus top tail-risk view among institutional investors, context for the sharper single-name moves this week.

disclaimer: Not financial advice. No indicator reliably times crashes; this composite raises the odds of a short heads-up, nothing more.
